classification: post-hoc Top20 width repair after R335 5x concentration failure; no parameter search
discipline: No TopN grid; Top20 is the single width response to R335.
No cap, asset, lookback or target-vol changes after seeing results.
No paper target or order file.
disclosure: R335 kept R334 return/drawdown under 4x/5x but 5x top-one/top-three/top-five stock contribution rose to 26.61%/63.68%/91.66%, failing concentration. R336 responds by widening each equity sleeve from Top10 to Top20 while keeping the R334 1/3 equity cap and all other rules fixed.

fixed_strategy.center: 60-day overlay lookback, 15% target vol, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage
fixed_strategy.costs: 2x/3x/4x/5x stock cost matrix with overlay costs 0.10%/0.15%/0.20%/0.25% respectively

known_limitations: In-sample candidate; not independent out-of-sample proof.
ETF qfq and current industry snapshot limitations remain.
Wider holdings may lower long-run return versus Top10.
selection_rule: All validation groups must pass; otherwise record the negative result and do not promote.

validation_required.cost_5x: total >0, Sharpe >=0.5, MDD >= -25%, 2022/2023 >=0, recent >0, and all concentration gates C1-C12
validation_required.fresh_starts: at least 4/5 positive and all MDD >= -18%
validation_required.full_2x: all R334/R332 performance and concentration gates with 2022/2023 >=0
validation_required.parameter_plateau: at least 7/9 overlay 40/60/90 × 12/15/18 variants and 2/3 joint target variants pass all gates
